name: Product build
use_case: A department that builds and ships a product to users (for example Deckem: paste an article, get the deck).
floor: Keeps one holder for every open work item and shows who holds what since when.
Records every hand-off between people or engines as a row: from, to, when, what.
Holds locks: two runs never write the same record at once; the second waits and says what it waits on.
Takes a stalled hand-off (a work item with no holder past its schedule) to Identity.
Design, build and review of a slice each have a named holder before work on the slice starts.
A shipped slice is handed to its first users with a named person to hear back from them.
choices: Who takes a work item when its holder is away.
Which of two conflicting runs waits.
Who hears back from the first users of a shipped slice.
reads: Open work items and their holders.
Locks and the runs holding them.
The slices in progress and who designs, builds and reviews each.
may_propose: Moving a work item to a new holder.
A hand-off rule between two engines or two people.
A named listener for the first users of a shipped slice.
schedule: On every hand-off and every lock, a sweep each hour for stalls, and when a slice starts or ships.
checks: Every open work item has exactly one holder.
Every hand-off this cycle has a row.
No lock was held past the end of its run.
Every slice started this cycle had named holders for design, build and review.
Every slice shipped this cycle has a named person hearing back from its first users.
